source: Tschopp et al. 2015, PeerJ 3, Fig. 119, first tree: Upchurch et al. (2004b) as redrawn in a comparison of nine published diplodocid trees; slanted (diagonal) cladogram drawn as a rectangular-style ladder, root at the bottom, tip names written upwards, a red outline around the Apatosaurus specimens, 'T: 16 (12) / C 32 (17)' beside it. The other eight trees are excluded. Image: census figure (3000x1642 px), the embedded raster.
region_note: the first tree (Upchurch et al. 2004b, top left)

names_note: no matrix held; list = the 16 printed tip names, mostly specimen numbers, with '"Elosaurus"' in quotation marks as printed
gold_note: Redrawn Upchurch et al. (2004b) tree. Slanted: each tip line runs down-left to the backbone, which is the CMNH 3378 line extended; the junctions were read from a 2x crop by following each line's slope. Polytomies: NSMT-PV 20375, YPM 1860 and YPM 1840 meet the AMNH 460 line at one point (four-way with the AMNH 460-YPM 1861 pair), and the UWGM 15556-'Elosaurus' pair and YPM 1980 meet it at another (three-way). The red outline marks a taxon group and carries no name. 16 tips, matching the printed 'T: 16'. 16 tips, 2 polytomies (3, 4 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261122). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
